name: Zombie Stories
desc:
Zombie Stories is a fast-paced, interactive, and thrilling story-mode FPS game.

You can team up with up to 5 other players to fight off zombies in various co-op missions or experience other enjoyable game modes. 

If you enjoyed the game, please leave a thumbs up!👍; It really supports us developers 🙂 

Keep in mind this is in Beta and is in heavy work in progress.

Only use the trading window to trade - other trading ways aren’t supported by Pandemic, and you may get scammed. We can’t help you if something happens in an unsupported trade. 

[Live Event]
Daily replays of the live event happen everyday at 5am and 5pm EDT. Ends 9/26.

scripts.title: infinite stamina
scripts.features:
an infinite stamina script for the game: Zombie stories
fuck you happy script
you suck happy script i hate you
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerScripts = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")

local framework = PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("ZS_Framework")
local modules = framework:WaitForChild("Modules")
local controllers = modules:WaitForChild("Controllers")
local lpControllerModule = controllers:WaitForChild("LocalPlayerController")

local controller = require(lpControllerModule)

if controller then
    if controller.InfiniteStamina then
        for i, v in pairs(debug.getupvalues(controller.InfiniteStamina)) do
            if type(v) == "number" then
                debug.setupvalue(controller.InfiniteStamina, i, 0)
            end
        end
    end

    controller.DrainStamina = function() end

    if controller.GetStamina then
        for i, v in pairs(debug.getupvalues(controller.GetStamina)) do
            if type(v) == "number" then
                debug.setupvalue(controller.GetStamina, i, 100)
            end
        end
    end
end
